Fit Scorer 19.0.0

- Improved instructions for handling typed context: now strictly requires all STAR target fields; if missing, returns NEEDS_INPUT and preserves user-supplied identity without inventing data.
- Revised critical-control evidence handling: no longer applies SQS cap or business veto in this skill; potential Fail items are passed for later gate review.
- Minor description and metadata updates; updated summary for bilingual clarity.
- Added distribution-manifest.json; removed outdated scoring template and skill card references.
